bodyStateHashEncoding: SHA256 over each alive body sorted by body slot: little-endian uint32 slot then binary32 position[3], quaternion[w,x,y,z], linearVelocity[3], angularVelocity[3]. One hash per fixed-step state.
rendering: Not measured; ordinary simulation/frame/presentation scripts execute. Timing excludes JSON serialization; individual fixtures ran sequentially.
